article.titolo: Il fondo americano Advent pronto ad aumentare la quota in Avio

verdict.text_en: The stock moved 2 sessions after the article (24 Aug 2026, -4.7%, 2.2 times the normal daily swing of the 20 sessions before the article); nothing unusual closed before publication. By 23 Sep 2026, the stock has moved further in the same direction since (193% of the move is in the price).
